verdict.rationale: Restate lets you query invocations and application state through its CLI and Introspection SQL API, export traces, and fetch OpenAPI 3.1 specs for services. It can also be self-hosted as a single binary, so data can stay in your own infrastructure and you can move off Restate Cloud. However, nothing documents a complete data export in open formats or a migration path off Restate. Missing for 10: an explicit full-data export feature, documented open export formats, migration/offboarding guidance, and independent confirmation of portability.
